chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Join Kids Heart Family  Hello Boys! What's going on over here?  We have a match against the teams from the other neighbourhood  but we can't agree upon anything.  Not even on who will be the captain and what kind of a game we will play.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Oh! That's bad!  You need to be a bundle of sticks boys and not single sticks.  What do you mean?  You'll know in just a few minutes.  Once upon a time an old farmer lived with his three sons.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: They were lucky to have a good crop every year and grew richer every year.  But they did not have any respect in the village because the sons kept fighting amongst themselves.  One day the farmer called his sons.  My sons, I am now growing old and it is time for me to retire.  But before I do so, I have a competition set for you all.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The winner will get a big reward from me.  What do we need to do father?  Here are three bundles of sticks.  Each bundle has ten sticks in it.  The one who breaks each stick the fastest will be the winner.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: It was an easy task and the sons broke each stick into two quickly.  As soon as they had done it, they started fighting again.  I won father.  How can you win when I broke all the sticks first?  I win.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: None of you broke the sticks as fast as I did.  So I am the winner.  Wait, the competition isn't over yet.  I still have one more task for you.  The farmer now handed over another bundle of ten sticks each to each son.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Now I want you to break the entire bundle of sticks into two.  Remember, you have to break the whole bundle at one go.  Don't pull out individual sticks.  The sons tried hard.  But they could not break their bundles.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Father, it is not possible to break the bundle.  Individual sticks can be broken.  Yes, the bundle is very very strong.  Exactly.  You three are also like the sticks.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: As long as you stay united like the bundle, nobody can break you.  But if you keep fighting amongst yourselves, you are like the individual sticks.  Easy to break.  The three sons understood the valuable lesson their father had taught them.  And never fought again.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: We have also been behaving like the three sons, Tia.  Isn't it?  We've been fighting amongst ourselves.  Yes, and if we continue like this, the other team will easily defeat us.  We will not fight anymore.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: We will find a way to play together like a real team.  That's a good decision boys.  All the best.  Thanks Tia.
